Data Analyst (m/f/d) — Northwind Mobility GmbH, Berlin (hybrid)

Northwind Mobility builds route-planning software for regional bus operators across Europe.
Our analytics team turns ticketing and GPS data into decisions about timetables and pricing.

What you'll do
- Own recurring KPI reporting for 30+ operator customers (ridership, punctuality, revenue)
- Build and maintain dbt models on top of our BigQuery warehouse
- Run ad-hoc analyses and A/B test evaluations for the product team
- Build self-service dashboards in Looker and train stakeholders to use them

What you bring
- 2+ years in a data analyst or BI role
- Strong SQL and Python (pandas); experience with dbt is a plus
- Solid statistics: hypothesis testing, regression, experiment design
- Clear communication in English; German is a plus

What we offer
- Hybrid work (2 office days in Berlin-Kreuzberg), 30 vacation days, learning budget
